title: Restriction augmentation for one injective étale sheaf on an open cover
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let i:X.Opens → X.Etale be cover preserving and preserve finite limits, and suppose i(top) is terminal [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let U be a finite u-small open covering of X. For any injective étale abelian sheaf J valued in AddCommGrpCat of universe u+1 [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], every map e from J(i(top)) concentrated in cochain degree zero to Cech(U,i^*J) [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex], whose degree-zero projections are restriction along i of the inclusions of tuple intersections into top, is a quasi-isomorphism. No resolution, total complex, or derived evaluation occurs in this assertion. Empty covers are allowed.

source.place: Lemma 21.10.2, including its degree-zero clause; Tag 03F6; row comparison in lem-sc-etale-open-cech-resolution-total, steps 1 and 2

proof.text: Finite-limit preservation makes i representably flat. Cover preservation then makes i continuous; apply op_comp_isSheaf to regard i.op composed with J.obj as an open sheaf. Prove degree-zero descent directly: the one-fold products cover top; the difference differential is compatibility on pairwise intersections; unique gluing identifies restriction with cycles. The component hypothesis he fixes e.f 0 to the restriction map by product projection uniqueness. CochainComplex.isIso_liftCycles_iff and ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_zeros show that e is a quasi-isomorphism in degree zero. The proof works also for an empty cover.

The open cover generates a covering sieve on top. Push it through hc, then enlarge it to the same family indexed by ULift(iota), using Sieve.mem_ofArrows_iff. Apply [lem-sc-etale-open-cech-product-comparison] to identify the pulled-back open Cech complex with the lifted image-family Cech complex.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-injective-sheaf-cech-acyclic] to the lifted image covering and J. Transport its zero positive homology across homologyMapIso of the comparison. The single source is exact in every positive degree, so quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt proves the positive-degree cases. Combine degree zero and successor degrees by the definition of QuasiIso.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 03AW positive vanishing and Tag 03AN degree-zero descent; product comparison as in the original proof step 1
